# Ana Beverin — Senior Product Designer

---

## About

I'm a senior product designer with 9 years of experience. I turn
ambiguity into clear direction, shaped flows, and visual systems that
are actually ready to hand to engineering.

Most of my career has been as the sole designer at startups, which
means I'm used to owning the full scope: discovery, IA, interaction
design, design systems, and working directly with founders and
engineers without a lot of process overhead.

Lately I've been working more in the design-to-code space — using
Cursor, Claude Code, and Figma MCP integration to build and prototype
in the browser, not just in Figma.

---

## Skills

Product design, visual design, brand identity, illustration,
interaction design, 0-to-1 product shaping, systems thinking,
user flows and information architecture, design systems,
interactive prototyping (Figma + code), design-to-code workflows,
frontend prototyping with React/Next.js/Tailwind.

Tools: Figma, Framer, Cursor, Claude Code, Adobe CC, Tailwind CSS,
React, Next.js, Vercel, GitHub, Linear, Notion, Slack.

---

## Work history

### Kofa Design — Independent Design Consultancy (2022–present)

My own consultancy for remote contract and freelance work. Recent
projects span developer tooling, AI infrastructure, marketplaces,
and SaaS.

**Shuttle** — Sole product designer from early traction to 20,000+
developers and 120,000+ deployments. Led a complete console audit and
redesign: consistent UI patterns, design system, and IA across dev
console, web, and growth surfaces.

**Neptune** — Brand identity and web experience for an AI
infrastructure platform. Built and shipped a scripted agent-chat
animation with AI, now live on the site.

**Dealio** — End-to-end marketplace design from concept to launch in
under a year. Simplified seller ad creation, improved buyer discovery,
structured buyer-seller communication. Launched with 78% CSAT.

**MixLodge** — MVP definition and end-to-end design for a marketplace
connecting musicians and producers. Covered discovery, booking, and
collaboration flows. Delivered implementation-ready architecture in
3 months.

### OptimoRoute — Lead Product Designer (2020–2022)

Led end-to-end product design for a route optimization platform used
by logistics teams worldwide. Managed a two-person design team. Helped
shift the product from engineering-first to design-driven.

Redesign increased returning session duration by 34%, improved
discoverability across Analytics, Dispatch, and Planning, and reduced
time-to-first-use at the 75th and 90th percentiles.

### Five Agency (now Endava) — Product Designer (2017–2020)

Owned design across client projects spanning mobile apps, web
products, and digital brand experiences. Led design workstreams,
collaborated with stakeholders and engineers, mentored junior
designers.

### Produkcija Pokret — Digital Designer, Illustrator (2016–2017)

Illustration systems, animated explainers, landing pages, and
marketing campaigns.
